purpose: Extracted metadata from user-provided CypCut LXDS samples for future calculator calibration.
warning: These are saved document presets, not proof of successful cutting on the user's HSG machine. Neither LXDS file contains a verified elapsed cutting time in the extracted metadata. Do not use these entries as machine-time ground truth.

geometry.boundingBoxNote: Bounding box dimensions are derived from model extents; they are not a sheet nesting.

cutLengthEstimate.method: Decoded six circle geometries from binary Geometry2D plus closed LwPolyline vertices; no quantity multiplier applied.
cutLengthEstimate.note: Geometry-only length for the one drawing contained in this file. Filename includes 'copy' but no repeat quantity is assumed.

pureCutTimeEstimate.includes: Contour length divided by note speed only
pureCutTimeEstimate.excludes: Pierces, lead-ins, acceleration/deceleration, corners, rapid moves, machine waits

warnings: Preset filename says 14 mm while document thickness is 10 mm.
Material parameter nozzle is D2.0E while preset filename says 3.5 nozzle.
Focus in note (5 mm) differs from Cut Focus (4).
WorkSpeed raw parameter (15) differs from note speed (0.8 m/min); do not treat raw WorkSpeed as m/min without decoding its unit/meaning.
Use 0.8 m/min only as a candidate reference from the note, not as a verified cut result.

cutLengthEstimate.method: Sum of each unique part outline from LXDS XML, multiplied by AmountUsed; added the 2 circle holes and outer contour from the referenced block geometry for the 15 inserted parts.
cutLengthEstimate.note: Straight segments between stored vertices are summed; this is the geometric contour length, not the actual CAM trajectory. The value includes part outer contours and the two circles in each of the 15 inserted parts.

pureCutTimeEstimate.includes: Total contour length divided by the saved note speed of 2.5 m/min
pureCutTimeEstimate.excludes: Pierces, lead-ins, acceleration/deceleration, corner slowdown, rapid moves, repositioning and machine waits
pureCutTimeEstimate.speedWarning: Technical/CamParams WorkSpeed is stored as 48.333, and the saved preset name indicates 5 mm/air while MaterialParams says 4 mm/cold-rolled sheet. 2.5 m/min is taken from the human-readable note only and is not confirmed as the actual speed used for every contour.

geometry.note: Index includes shape definitions/objects and is not equal to the number of placed parts.

warnings: Filename says 5 mm, but MaterialParams thickness is 4 mm.
Preset path indicates stainless steel/air, while MaterialParams says cold-rolled sheet.
The cut gas type is not explicitly present in the Cut node; the pressure value 10 has no decoded unit in this extraction.
Use 2.5 m/min only as a candidate reference from the note, not as a verified cut result.

nextCalibrationInputsNeeded: Compare the pure-cut estimate with CypCut's own estimated processing time for each nest result.
Confirm the actual speed/regime applied in the job (saved note says 2.5 m/min but raw WorkSpeed is 48.333).
For a machine-time estimate, add pierce counts/times, lead-ins, head dynamics and rapid moves.
Actual start-to-finish machine time is needed to calibrate the non-cutting overhead.
